name: 36142-forcedregex-gemma312b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration; this workload exercises the text tower (`gemma3_text`) only. Shapes, FP8 quantization_config and window are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 100 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% discarded as warmup.
workload: 100 identical rows in `configs/data/sentence-split-100.jsonl`: a `system_prompt` column asking for accurate sentence splitting and a `prompt` column holding a 355-character news paragraph, put through the checkpoint's own chat template by `request_format: default-template` for 129 prompt tokens. Generation is pinned by `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.regex` in `configs/scenario.json`; temperature 0.0, max_tokens 4096, and no `output_tokens` is declared, so the constraint rather than a fixed length ends each request.
purpose: A sentence-splitting service for news text, returning pattern-constrained output one request at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# FLAT YAML ONLY: indented lines are skipped and a value is truncated at the first `#`, so a
# structured value must stay on one line and no value may contain `#`.
model: RedHatAI/gemma-3-12b-it-FP8-dynamic
structured-outputs-config: {"backend":"guidance"}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
# OFF against the V1 default of on, and load-bearing: every request carries the SAME prompt, so
# with caching on all but the first prefill would be served out of cache.
enable-prefix-caching: false
no-async-scheduling: true
dtype: bfloat16
